objective: Diagnose Run #7's common simulator E2E failure from authoritative GitHub evidence, apply the smallest safe fix, validate locally, push normally, and gate a fresh macOS rerun.

authoritative_run.evidence_scope: authenticated GitHub Actions job metadata and downloaded artifacts; no secrets recorded

evidence: All small, mainstream, large, and ipad legs recorded SIMULATOR_BOOT PASS and APP_BUILD FAIL.
Every attempted flow artifact recorded APP_INSTALL, APP_LAUNCH, APP_READY, TEST_DRIVER_ATTACH, TEST_DISCOVERY, and FLOW_EXECUTION as SKIPPED.

APP_BUILD logs showed flutter build ios --config-only selecting device (ios-release) and failing with No valid code signing certificates were found / No development certificates available to code sign app for device deployment.
Preflight and flow05-host-fake were successful; simulator boot and baseline privacy setup were successful.

follow_up_rerun.evidence_scope: authenticated downloaded artifacts; no secrets recorded
evidence: preflight and flow05-host-fake passed; all simulator legs booted successfully.
ipad, small, and large artifacts recorded APP_BUILD FAIL exit=65 with install, launch, discovery, and flow execution skipped; mainstream was still running when the partial artifacts were captured.
RunnerTests link failed under Xcode 26.6 with missing swiftCompatibility56, swiftCompatibilityConcurrency, swiftCompatibilityPacks, CoreAudioTypes, and UIUtilities symbols/frameworks.
The failure occurred after the --simulator targeting fix and is consistent with static CocoaPods framework linkage under Xcode 26, not signing contamination or the legacy VM-service attach path.
follow_up_rerun.next_fix: Pin the simulator-only E2E workflow to the macOS 15/Xcode 16 image; preserve the production Podfile and signing/upload boundaries.

run9_rerun.evidence_scope: authenticated downloaded large artifact; no secrets recorded
evidence: preflight and flow05-host-fake passed; large reached the bounded XCTest stage after the --simulator and dynamic-linkage changes.
large artifact recorded APP_BUILD FAIL exit=65 with install, launch, discovery, and flow execution skipped.
RunnerTests still failed under Xcode 26.6 with missing swiftCompatibility56, swiftCompatibilityConcurrency, swiftCompatibilityPacks, CoreAudioTypes, and UIUtilities symbols/frameworks.
Dynamic use_frameworks! did not resolve this app's vendored Swift framework link failure, so the temporary Podfile change was reverted to protect the production CocoaPods contract.
run9_rerun.next_fix: Run the simulator XCTest architecture on macos-15, whose documented default is Xcode 16.4, while leaving production release on its existing runner contract.

changes.summary: Make the Flutter config-only APP_BUILD explicitly simulator-targeted with --simulator; add non-recursive EXIT handling that propagates cleanup watchdog failure.
Require --simulator in the actual config-only block and require fail-closed cleanup exit propagation.
Evaluated dynamic CocoaPods linkage in b7cd59d4; Run #9 reproduced the same Xcode 26.6 link failure, so the temporary change was reverted and the production Podfile remains canonical.
Require the simulator E2E workflow to pin all three jobs to macos-15 instead of the floating Xcode 26 macos-latest image.
Pin preflight, host FLOW5, and simulator matrix jobs to macos-15/Xcode 16 generation based on the Run #8/#9 Xcode 26.6 linker evidence.
